# nd_remote_storage_location (Data Source)

Datasource of the remote storage location for Nexus Dashboard

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nd_remote_storage_location" "test_datasource_remote_storage_location_1" {
  name = "scp-server"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name that uniquely identifies the remote storage location datasource.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the remote storage location.
- `health_state` (String) The health state of the remote storage location.
- `health_state_message` (String) The health state message of the remote storage location.
- `hostname` (String) The hostname or IP address of the remote storage server.
- `nfs` (Attributes) The NFS remote storage configuration. Null for SCP/SFTP storage locations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nfs))
- `path` (String) The export path for NFS storage or the base path for SCP/SFTP storage on the remote server.
- `scp_sftp` (Attributes) The SCP or SFTP remote storage configuration. Null for NFS storage locations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scp_sftp))

<a id="nestedatt--nfs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nfs`

Read-Only:

- `alert_threshold` (Number) The storage usage percentage that triggers an alert when exceeded.
- `limit` (String) The storage capacity limit for the NFS remote storage location.
- `port` (Number) The port number of the NFS server.
- `read_write` (Boolean) Indicates whether the NFS storage location is read-write.


<a id="nestedatt--scp_sftp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scp_sftp`

Read-Only:

- `ignore_host_key_validation` (Boolean) Indicates whether host-key validation is skipped for the SCP or SFTP server.
- `port` (Number) The port number of the SCP or SFTP server.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol used by the remote storage location, either `scp` or `sftp`.
- `username` (String) The username used to authenticate with the SCP or SFTP server.
